purpose: Blinded source judgment of eleven connected Zhang Jun diplomatic-dispatch and memorial claims; no proposed operations or desired verdicts included
question: Judge ownership and chronology using all Chinese, including flashback, dated arrival, next-year heading, contemporary memorial, and subsequent dispatches. Preserve exact source wording and any real period/conversion or owner conflict. Supported one-sided knowledge is permissible but cannot replace a precise date or turn all quoted people into currently living participants. Do not infer exact years, lifespan/reign intervals, or calendar endpoints from seven-year duration without a justified counting rule. No need to correct all items: holds are valid. Return an independent source-specific judgment for every selected claim.

value.unresolvedReason: 後駿遣參軍麹護 follows 九年 (s0468) without a new era year. It is not Xiankang 1.

units.zh: 初，建興中，敦煌計吏耿訪到長安，既而遇賊，不得反，奔漢中，因東渡江，乙太興二年至京都，屢上書，以本州未知中興，宜遣大使，乞為鄉導。
units.en: Early in the Jianxing era, Dunhuang clerk Geng Fang reached Chang’an, met bandits, fled to Hanzhong, crossed east over the Yangzi, and in the second year of Taixing reached the capital, repeatedly memorializing that his home province did not know of the restoration and begging to serve as guide.
units.literal: In the beginning, in the Jianxing era, Dunhuang clerk Geng Fang reached Chang’an, then met bandits and could not return; he fled to Hanzhong, crossed the Yangzi eastward, and in the second year of Taixing reached the capital; he repeatedly submitted memorials that his home province did not know of the restoration and ought to dispatch a great envoy, begging to serve as guide.

units.zh: 時連有內難，許而未行。
units.en: At that time troubles followed one another within the court; they granted the request but did not carry it out.
units.literal: At that time troubles followed one another within the court; they granted it but did not carry it out.

units.zh: 至是，始以訪守治書御史，拜駿鎮西大將軍，校尉、刺史、公如故，選西方人隴西賈陵等十二人配之。
units.en: At this point they first appointed Fang acting imperial secretary and invested Zhang Jun as Grand General Who Garrisons the West, with colonel, inspector, and duke as before, and chose twelve western men including Jia Ling of Longxi to accompany him.
units.literal: At this point they first appointed Fang acting imperial secretary and invested Jun as Grand General Who Garrisons the West; colonel, inspector, and duke as before, and chose twelve western men including Jia Ling of Longxi to accompany him.

units.zh: 訪停梁州七年，以驛道不通，召還。
units.en: Fang stayed in Liangzhou seven years; because the post road was not open, he was recalled.
units.literal: Fang stayed in Liangzhou seven years; because the post road was not open, he was recalled.

units.zh: 訪以詔書付賈陵，托為賈客。
units.en: Fang handed the edict to Jia Ling, entrusting him to pose as a merchant.
units.literal: Fang handed the edict to Jia Ling, entrusting him to pose as a merchant.

units.zh: 到長安，不敢進，以咸和八年始達涼州。
units.en: Reaching Chang’an, he did not dare go farther; it was only in the eighth year of Xianhe that he arrived in Liangzhou.
units.literal: When he reached Chang’an he did not dare advance; only in the eighth year of Xianhe did he reach Liangzhou.

units.zh: 駿受詔，遣部曲督王豐等報謝，並遣陵歸，上疏稱臣，而不奉正朔，猶稱建興二十一年。
units.en: Zhang Jun received the edict, sent troop commander Wang Feng and others to return thanks, and also sent Ling back; he submitted a memorial declaring himself subject but did not adopt the standard calendar, still calling it the twenty-first year of Jianxing.
units.literal: Jun received the edict, sent troop commander Wang Feng and others to return thanks, and also sent Ling back; he submitted a memorial declaring himself subject but did not adopt the standard calendar, still calling it the twenty-first year of Jianxing.

units.zh: 九年，復使訪隨豐等齎印板進駿大將軍。
units.en: In the ninth year he again sent Fang with Feng and others carrying seals to advance Zhang Jun to grand general.
units.literal: In the ninth year he again sent Fang with Feng and others carrying seals to advance Jun to grand general.

units.zh: 自是每歲使命不絕。
units.en: From this time envoys every year were uninterrupted.
units.literal: From this time envoys every year were uninterrupted.

units.zh: 後駿遣參軍麹護上疏曰：
units.en: Later Zhang Jun sent adjutant Qu Hu to submit a memorial saying:
units.literal: Later Jun sent adjutant Qu Hu to submit a memorial saying:

units.zh: 東西隔塞，逾歷年載，夙承聖德，心系本朝。
units.en: East and west have been cut off from one another for years; I have long received the sagely virtue, and my heart is bound to the imperial court.
units.literal: East and west are blocked and separated, passing years on end; long I have received sagely virtue and my heart ties to the capital court.

units.zh: 而江吳寂蔑，餘波莫及，雖肆力修塗，同盟靡恤。
units.en: Yet Jiang and Wu are silent and remote, and their remaining influence does not reach us. Though I exhaust my strength repairing the road, our allies show no concern.
units.literal: Yet the Jiang and Wu region is silent and remote; the lingering wave cannot reach; though I exhaust strength on the road, the covenant allies show no pity.

units.zh: 奉詔之日，悲喜交並，天恩光被，褒崇輝渥，即以臣為大將軍、都督陝西雍秦涼州諸軍事。
units.en: Receiving the patent, he felt joy and grief together, awed that grace should raise him to grand general and commander of the military affairs of the region west of Shan and the provinces of Yong, Qin, and Liang.
units.literal: On the day I received the edict, joy and grief crossed; Heaven’s grace shines on me, glorious favor heaps high, and at once your subject was made grand general and area commander of Shaanxi, Yong, Qin, and Liang military affairs.

units.zh: 休寵振赫，萬里懷戴，嘉命顯至，銜感屏營。
units.en: The favor shone far; all within ten thousand li looked up in loyalty; the gracious order dazzled him and he trembled with gratitude.
units.literal: The rest and favor shake brilliance; ten thousand li cherish and support; the gracious command shone forth and I bore gratitude in awe.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下天挺岐嶷，堂構晉室，遭家不造，播幸吳楚，宗廟有《黍離》之哀，園陵有殄廢之痛，普天咨嗟，含氣悲傷。
units.en: He extolled the emperor’s sagely gifts yet mourned the ancestral temples’ Millet Odes sorrow and the ruined imperial tombs.
units.literal: I bow my head: Your Majesty is heaven-endowed with keen intelligence and builds the house of Jin; meeting ill fortune in the family, you wander in Wu and Chu; the ancestral temples have the sorrow of Millet’s Odes, the park tombs the pain of ruin; all under heaven sighs and every breathing creature grieves.

units.zh: 臣專命一方，職在斧鉞，遐域僻陋，勢極秦隴。
units.en: He pledged the axe of command to hold the far west for the throne, his power reaching only to Qin and Long.
units.literal: Your subject holds sole command in one quarter; my office is the axe and halberd; the distant region is remote and crude, my strength ends at Qin and Long.

units.zh: 勒雄既死，人懷反正，謂季龍、李期之命曾不崇朝，而皆篡繼凶逆，鴟目有年。
units.en: With Shi Le and Li Xiong gone, he had hoped Shi Hu and Li Qi would fall in a morning, yet both usurped the line and glared like owls for years.
units.literal: Le and Xiong are dead and men cherish return to rectitude; I thought Ji Hu and Li Qi’s fate would not last a morning, yet both usurped succession, cruel and rebellious, owl-eyed for years.

units.zh: 東西遼曠，聲援不接，遂使桃蟲鼓翼，四夷喧嘩，向義之徒更思背誕，鉛刀有幹將之志，螢燭希日月之光。
units.en: East and west lay too far apart for aid, so grain borers beat their wings, barbarians clamored, wavering loyalists thought of rebellion, and lead knives dreamed of being Ganjiang.
units.literal: East and west stretch boundlessly and voice and aid do not connect, so the peach-borer beats its wings and the four barbarians clamor; those who faced righteousness now think of turning back; lead knives aspire to the keenness of Ganjiang, fireflies hope for sun and moon light.

units.zh: 是以臣前章懇切，欲齊力時討。
units.en: Therefore his earlier memorial had pleaded earnestly for a joint, timely strike.
units.literal: Therefore your servant’s earlier memorial was earnest, wishing to join strength and strike in season.

units.zh: 而陛下雍容江表，坐觀禍敗，懷目前之安，替四祖之業，馳檄佈告，徒設空文，臣所以宵吟荒漠，痛心長路者也。
units.en: Yet the throne dallied south of the Yangzi, watched disaster, clung to present peace, cast away the four ancestors’ work, and issued empty edicts—why he wailed nights on desert roads.
units.literal: Yet Your Majesty at ease south of the Yangzi sits watching calamity and defeat, cherishing peace before your eyes and casting aside the work of the four ancestors; proclamations and notices are only empty writing—this is why your servant chants at night in the desert and grieves along the long road.

units.zh: 且兆庶離主，漸冉經世，先老消落，後生靡識，忠良受梟懸之罰，群凶貪縱橫之利，懷君戀故，日月告流。
units.en: The people had long lost their lord; elders died and youths knew no Jin; good men were executed while villains profited; memory of the old house ebbed like sun and moon.
units.literal: Moreover the myriad common folk have left their lord; gradually a generation passes; the old die off and the young know nothing; the loyal and good suffer owl-display punishment while villainous clans grasp profit in wanton license; longing for the lord and old home flows like sun and moon.

units.zh: 雖時有尚義之士，畏逼首領，哀歎窮廬。
units.en: Even men of honor, fearing for their heads, could only weep in hovels.
units.literal: Though from time to time there are men who honor duty, they fear for their heads and wail in poor huts.

units.zh: 臣聞少康中興，由於一旅，光武嗣漢，眾不盈百，祀夏配天，不失舊物，況以荊揚栗悍，臣州突騎，吞噬遺羯，在於掌握哉！
units.en: He cited Shaokang’s single brigade and Guangwu’s hundred men to show a tiny host can restore a dynasty—surely fierce Jing and Yang plus Liangzhou’s shock horse could devour the remnant Jie.
units.literal: Your servant has heard that Shaokang’s restoration rose from one brigade, Guangwu continued Han with fewer than a hundred men, sacrificed to Xia and matched Heaven without losing the old inheritance—how much more with Jing and Yang fierce and your subject’s province’s shock cavalry, swallowing the remnant Jie, lies in the hollow of the hand!

units.zh: 願陛下敷弘臣慮，永念先績，敕司空鑒、征西亮等泛舟江沔，使首尾俱至也。
units.en: He begged the emperor to widen his plan, remember past merit, and order Yu Liang’s hosts onto the Jiang and Mian so both ends of the realm could strike together.
units.literal: I beg Your Majesty to spread wide your servant’s thought, ever remember former merit, and order Minister of Works Jian and Grand General Who Conquers the West Liang to float boats on the Jiang and Mian so head and tail may both arrive."

units.zh: 自後駿遣使多為季龍所獲，不達。
units.en: After that, Zhang Jun’s envoys were often captured by Shi Hu and never arrived.
units.literal: Afterward Jun’s envoys were mostly taken by Ji Hu and did not get through.

units.zh: 後駿又遣護羌參軍陳宇、從事徐虓、華馭等至京師，征西大將軍亮上疏言陳宇等冒險遠至，宜蒙銓敘，詔除寓西平相，虓等為縣令，
units.en: Later Zhang Jun sent Chen Yu, Xu Xiao, and Hua Yu to the capital; Yu Liang memorialized their perilous journey and won them appointments as chancellor of Xiping and county magistrates.
units.literal: Later Jun again sent Colonel aide Chen Yu, aides Xu Xiao and Hua Yu and others to the capital; Grand General Who Conquers the West Liang submitted a memorial saying Chen Yu and the others braved danger to come from afar and ought to receive appointments; an edict appointed Yu west-ping minister and Xiao and the others county magistrates.

units.zh: 永和元年，以世子重華為五官中郎將、涼州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Yonghe, he named crown prince Zhang Chonghua general of the gentlemen of the household for all purposes and inspector of Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the first year of Yonghe, (The line continues) he appointed heir apparent Chonghua as General of the Gentlemen of the Household for All Purposes and inspector of Liangzhou.
